author: Yrsie
quote: Wow… I have 30,000 hours on GTA 5 and 10,000 on Red Dead Redemption II. I’ve played almost every Rockstar game: GTA 3, GTA SA, GTA VC, GTA IV, and GTA 5, but this is truly awful—what a letdown… It’s an EXTREMELY unpolished game, not the usual masterpiece. I hope they can save this game with the online mode.
